name: Timeline
description: One row per milestone: year | title | image | description, and an optional fifth cell: the space above the title in px (e.g. 15). Title lines are separate lines or paragraphs in the cell, the model in bold. A blank cell is a blank value: no image, no image box; no year, no year pill; an empty row is skipped. Links open in a new tab. A left line on phones and tablets, two-sided from 1080px wide.

options.label: black
options.description: Black year pills and dots instead of the green default (125 years of Škoda: iconic cars).

options.label: large
options.description: Larger titles (24px), for timelines whose source titles are 18pt.

options.label: xl
options.description: Title paragraphs sized by role: the maker line 24px, the all-bold model line 32px, the "(vehicle on display: …)" line 16px (wheels, gear stick).
